query.statement: INSERT INTO TB_INTERVIEWSCHEDULE (INTERVIEWSCHEDULE_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, SYSDATE, ?, SYSDATE)
SELECT INTERVIEWSCHEDULE_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, UPDATED_AT FROM TB_INTERVIEWSCHEDULE WHERE NAME LIKE '%' || ? || '%' AND STATUS_CD = ? ORDER BY UPDATED_AT DESC
SELECT INTERVIEWSCHEDULE_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT FROM TB_INTERVIEWSCHEDULE WHERE INTERVIEWSCHEDULE_ID = ?
UPDATE TB_INTERVIEWSCHEDULE SET NAME = ?, STATUS_CD = ?, UPDATED_BY = ?, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE INTERVIEWSCHEDULE_ID = ?
